roles.name: Name
roles.exposeSelfAssignHint: Self-selectable roles in this category appear automatically in the self-assignable roles widget when enabled.
roles.defaultTemplateHint: New roles and synced roles in this category inherit these settings (permissions, display, scope, and type).
roles.categoriesHelp: Categories organize this list. Drag roles within a tab to reorder. Save changes to sync.
roles.manageAllCategories: Manage and assign roles in all categories
roles.manageAllCategoriesHint: When off, members with this role can only manage or assign roles in the same category (unless they also hold a global role).
roles.roleTypeHint: Mixed matches the compact role model. Authority stays off the public role list for members without Manage Roles. Visual is cosmetic only (no permission grants).
roles.visualHint: Visual roles only change how this role looks in the UI; they never grant server permission flags.
roles.displaySeparately: Display role separately in member list
roles.defaultRoleAssign: Default role — assign to new members
roles.defaultRoleHint: Everyone already has {'@'}members; use this for extra roles (for example Member).
roles.linkOthers: Link other roles when this one is assigned
roles.linkOptional: Optional — also assign other roles automatically.
roles.authorityHint: Authority roles skip color and visibility styling. They stay hidden from members who cannot manage roles while still contributing permission grants (see the Permissions tab).
roles.visualNoPerms: Visual roles never grant server permissions in Echo, so there is nothing to configure here.
roles.noMembers: No members currently use this role.
roles.permPreviewHint: Effective permissions for your account (server fold, then category and channel layers). Requires manage roles or manage server.
roles.noServerContext: Server context is not available for permission preview.
roles.highPermsBody: This role has elevated permissions. If it is assigned to every new member automatically, everyone joining will receive those capabilities—including moderation or server management, if enabled.
roles.highPermsConfirm: Only continue if this is intentional (for example a private staff server).
roles.keepCurrentHint: Leave this role’s permissions, color, and display options as they are.

type.authorityTitle: Authority — hidden from most members; still grants permissions
type.visualTitle: Visual — cosmetic only; no permission grants

roles.addMemberFailed: Could not add member to this role.
roles.emptyCategory: No roles in this category. Open {all}, drag a role onto this tab, or create a role.
roles.namesSaveHint: Names save immediately. Role list changes use {save} below.
roles.linkExplain: When this role is assigned, also assign the roles below. {oneWay} applies from this role only; {twoWay} mirrors when the other role is assigned alone.
roles.syncMoveBody: Move this role into {category}. Choose whether it should inherit that category’s defaults or keep its current permissions and display settings.
roles.syncApply: Apply {category} defaults for permissions and display.
